title: From Data Scarcity to Data Care: Reimagining Language Technologies for Serbian and other Low-Resource Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on the sociotechnical and ethical aspects of data curation for low-resource languages, proposing a framework called 'Data Care' based on CARE principles (including Ethics). While it addresses the ethics of AI development and representational justice, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or faith-based content in models.
